$comment: Activities in Fin-City Park. kind = component in src/activities/registry.tsx. entry/advanced = parameters per difficulty (a 'kind' inside overrides the component). stars = score thresholds for 1/2/3 stars. rewards are per star count. Arcade games charge `fee` and pay `tickets`.

activities.name: First Quiz
activities.blurb: Five warm-up questions about money. Narwhal explains every answer.
activities.entryBlurb: Five easy money questions! I'll help you with every one.

activities.name: Fin City Quiz Show
activities.blurb: Eight questions from every corner of Fin City, game-show style with a timer bonus.
activities.entryBlurb: A game show! Answer quickly for bonus points!

activities.name: Teller Trainee
activities.blurb: Work the teller window: count customers' deposits and keep account records straight.
activities.entryBlurb: Count the coins and bills customers bring to the bank!

activities.name: Credit Score Simulator
activities.blurb: Make 24 months of credit decisions and watch a credit score rise or fall. Reach 740+ with the lowest cost.
activities.entryBlurb: A story about borrowing and being trustworthy.

activities.name: What Do Taxes Pay For?
activities.blurb: Sort things into what taxes pay for and what families pay for themselves.

activities.name: Coin Catcher
activities.blurb: Catch falling coins and bills, dodge the sneaky fees! $1 per game.
activities.entryBlurb: Catch the falling money! Watch out for the red bills!

activities.name: Money Memory
activities.blurb: Flip cards to match money words with their meanings. $1 per game.
activities.entryBlurb: Find the matching coin pairs! $1 per game.

activities.name: Price Dash
activities.blurb: Two price tags, one second to pick the better deal. How many can you get? $1 per game.
activities.entryBlurb: Tap the cheaper one, fast! $1 per game.

activities.name: Pet Care Budget
activities.blurb: Plan a month of pet care: needs first, then the fun extras, without going over budget.

activities.name: Buy, Borrow or Lease?
activities.blurb: Compare the true cost of buying with cash, an auto loan, or a lease, and pick the best deal for each driver.
activities.entryBlurb: Which ride is the best deal? Look at the price AND the cost every month.

activities.name: Mortgage Math
activities.blurb: Down payments, monthly payments and total interest on a home loan. Calculator allowed!
activities.entryBlurb: Questions about renting and buying a home.

activities.name: Trip Planner
activities.blurb: Plan a trip to a world city on a budget: travel, hotel, food and fun.

activities.name: Odd Jobs Board
activities.blurb: Quick jobs around the park. Do a good job, get paid!
